subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & payment path for GreenPeak
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Barnes <trevor@greenpeak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & procurement checklist (GreenPeak)

Hi Trevor — great to meet today, really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your AP team has what they need to decide between PO vs corporate card or marketplace procurement: 

- Our ask: confirm preferred commercial path (PO, card, or marketplace) and any approval thresholds (e.g., card single-transaction limits, annual contract routing).
- Procurement requirements we heard on the call: vendor registration, W-9, SOC2 summary, standard redlines to SOW/PO terms.
- Possible pathing: if GreenPeak can approve vendor on the marketplace we can expedite onboarding (no PO needed). If AP requires PO, we can support standard net-30 with invoice PDF + PO number.

I attached a short SOC2 summary and our W-9; also including a one-page vendor intake form your AP can use to speed the vendor creation.

Next steps: can you confirm (1) whether AP prefers PO vs card for this supplier class, (2) an upper card threshold (if card is possible), and (3) who on your side will own the vendor intake (name + email)?

Thanks — happy to coordinate with Marissa and our finance team to close any gaps.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: RDW_W9_GreenPeak.pdf, RDW_SOC2-Summary.pdf, Vendor-Onboarding-Form.docx

From: Trevor Barnes <trevor@greenpeak.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenPeak Procurement <procurement@greenpeak.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2028 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement checklist (GreenPeak)

Michael — thanks for the notes and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from AP: 

- GreenPeak prefers to use PO for new vendors that will be invoiced monthly; our thresholds for corporate card are generally up to $10,000 per transaction but cards require vendor to be on our payment gateway.
- We do have a marketplace preference for SaaS vendors who are already listed there — that short-circuits a lot of the onboarding. Do you have a marketplace listing?
- Required docs: W-9 (US), SOC2 summary or equivalent, and vendor registration form. If there are standard MSAs we should review those — send the SOW/terms you expect us to sign.

I own vendor intake at GreenPeak (Trevor Barnes), but finance will be the approver. I'll route your attachments to the AP team; if you can complete the vendor intake fields at the link you included that will help.

Trevor
Procurement Lead, GreenPeak Systems
procurement@greenpeak.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Barnes <trevor@greenpeak.io>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement checklist (GreenPeak)

Hi Trevor — looping in Jasmine from our finance/onboarding team to make this as frictionless as possible. Quick notes from our side: 

- Marketplace: we are live on the MajorCloud marketplace (listing ID: redwood-inference), and can provide a Marketplace Purchase Order (MP) flow that meets most procurement controls — this would remove the need for a custom vendor record in many cases.
- If GreenPeak needs a PO route, we typically accept Net 30 with electronic invoices and an invoice-to PO matching workflow.
- For card payments, we can accept corporate card for pilot amounts and offer invoice credit terms once vendor creation is complete.

Jasmine — can you confirm the expected timeline to turn around vendor registration once Trevor sends the completed intake form and flag any terms that commonly cause delay?

Trevor — we'll also attach a short SOW template that our legal team prefers; if you have counter-MSA notes we can surface them early to avoid redlines later.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Trevor Barnes <trevor@greenpeak.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenPeak Procurement <procurement@greenpeak.io>
Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement checklist (GreenPeak)

Perfect — marketplace sounds promising. My procurement team will confirm whether they can route through MajorCloud marketplace; if they can, we prefer that route to avoid vendor creation.

Action items from GreenPeak: I'll confirm by EOD Thursday whether AP will accept marketplace MP flow or will require us to create a vendor record and issue PO. If vendor record required, I'll complete the vendor intake and return it to you (Michael).

I'll also flag Finance to look at the SOW template once you share it — we aim to keep legal redlines minimal for pilots.

Trevor

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Barnes <trevor@greenpeak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement checklist (GreenPeak)

Thanks Trevor — really appreciate the quick turnaround. Two small follow-ups: 

1) If GreenPeak confirms marketplace route, we'll submit the marketplace MP quote and can start the pilot as soon as you accept.
2) If AP needs vendor record + PO, please send the completed intake to me and I'll mark it high priority with Jasmine to accelerate vendor creation.

If it helps, we'll prepare a short one-page pilot agreement (no commercial terms beyond the quote) to minimize legal review time — I can share that by EOD today.

Best,
Michael
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
